about: The Marvel Super Heroes sourcebooks this repo reads, one entry per book, keyed by slug.
Marvel's own registry: scripts/books.json is the Palladium books' and is not read or written by anything in scripts/msh/.

title, short, game  the book's name, the code a card cites it by (MA1), and the game it is for as the cover names it (Marvel Super Heroes, or Marvel Super Heroes Advanced Set); game is a record only, read by no script in scripts/msh/
ORDER MATTERS: the first book here keeps plain ids (magneto); every later one's ids end in -<slug> (magneto-mhsp1), so no two books collide and no id depends on build order
source_pdf, source_pdf_dir  where scripts/msh/ocr-book.py reads the scan from
sha256          of that PDF, so a different scan of the same book is noticed
pdf_pages       the PDF's page count; the OCR cache names pages p001..pNNN by PDF page
offset          printed page = PDF page - offset
offset_evidence how the offset was measured
columns         text columns on a body page
stat_labels     the four secondary values printed beside the FASERIP grid, in the book's spelling
section_labels  the run-in headings that divide an entry, in the book's spelling
rank_aliases    rank codes as this book prints them -> apps/marvel-heroes/data/ranks.json ids, misprints included
sections        the printed Contents: [section, subsection or null, printed first page]
contents_errata where the Contents and the pages disagree: {section, contents_page, page, note}; the page wins
character_pages the printed range scripts/msh/roster.py reads for characters; the rest of the book is items and an adventure
item_pages      the printed range scripts/msh/extras.py reads for items and locations
item_parts      run-in names that are PARTS of an item or location, not new ones (the Danger Room's event kinds)

adventure       the book's adventure: its title and printed range, for scripts/msh/extras.py; the maps after it are not text. Adventures are not in the app (2026-09-29): extras.py parses one only for the items found inside it, so only MHSP1 has one, and a new book leaves this out
index           the printed index: [name, [printed pages]], transcribed and checked against the page images

index_aliases   {name as the index prints it: name as the entries read}: an index name that is a misprint or a different form of a character's (MA1's Nightrawler, MA4's Galactus's Ships), so scripts/msh/roster.index_misses and scripts/msh/survey.py count it found

parts           a boxed module of several booklets, each numbered from 1: {name, cite (the booklet as a card cites it), pdf: [first, last], offset or null}; replaces offset, which assumes one numbering

layout          how the character pages are set: absent for MA1's (scripts/msh/roster.py); roster-booklet for MHSP1's (scripts/msh/booklet.py); grid-booklets for ME1's, MA1's grids in a boxed module (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py)
character_ranges  a grid-booklets book: [{part, pages: [first, last] printed}] that scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads for characters
opponents       a grid-booklets book: adventure pages that stat a character inside their prose, {part, page, names}; an entry there ends where the prose resumes
roster_sections Contents sections whose sub-entries are characters, a checklist every name of which must be found
tiers           statted generic types the Contents does not list by that name (Typical Skrull Warrior), a checklist too
teams           [part, first printed page, team]: the team of an entry is the last one at or before its first page
character_part  with parts: the booklet character_pages counts in
item_part       with parts: the booklet item_pages counts in

locations       a roster-booklet book's locations: {name, section (the adventure section that describes it), parts, part_aliases, items (run-ins inside it that are items), rooms (its room table: columns, and rows of [sector, d100 range, a room per column], transcribed by eye)}
vehicles        vehicles a roster-booklet book states inside an adventure section: {name, section}; control, speed and body are read from that section

adventure_tables  tables inside adventure sections that the column cut cannot read as prose: {section, pdf, box (TSV pixels) cut out of the text, note}. Only the box is read: the adventure is not in the app, so no table is carried as data

adventure.sections  a roster-booklet book's adventure, in page order: [kind, title, how its first line reads, extra]; kind setting, planned (the third field is its day and shift, and a fourth its first words where OCR lost its title), random (extra: its roll, and "once"), location, or skip (running notes, which are on the characters)
one_line_tiers  one-line blocks that are beings of their own, not a form of the character (Klaw's sound creatures)
running         a booklet of running notes, one per character: {part, pages, aliases: {name as the note prints it: entry header}}
reference_summary a chart of every character's ranks, Health and Karma: {pdf, heroes, villains}, rows [name, "F A S E R I P" as printed, Health, Karma, [powers]], transcribed by eye
sections (with parts) a fourth field names the booklet whose Contents lists the entry, since each booklet numbers from 1 (ME1)

reference_summary rows may give the seven ranks as a list of the printed values, number and code, where the chart prints both (ME1); a grid-booklets book's chart names its part and the team its chart-only heroes join
layout code-grids for MA4's grids, whose rows print the code before the number ("F GD (10)"): scripts/msh/codegrids.py

headings        a code-grids book: [printed page, TITLE] titles that are not characters (a race, a place, a group); each opens a heading entry and must be found once. ' / ' joins a title set on two lines. A third field names the tier its run-ins are members of (NOTABLE SKRULLS: SKRULL)
item_headers    a code-grids book: [printed page, TITLE, location|vehicle] for each place and vehicle scripts/msh/extras.py reads in item_pages, matched once in capitals
grid_headers    a code-grids book: [printed page, Health, NAME] for a character header the OCR lost; a line with the name goes in above that grid
block_labels    a code-grids book: [printed page, Health, label] for a grid that is a form or an item inside another entry (The Thing's Human Form); it gets no header of its own

page_columns    a code-grids book: [printed page, columns] for an item page laid out in a column count other than the book's (MA4's 2x2 floor-plan grid, printed 77, is two); scripts/msh/codegrids.py items() builds its stream a page at a time so one page can differ

plan_keys       a code-grids book: [printed page, TITLE] for a floor plan's key set beside the plan, each found once on its page; a key runs to the next title or the page's end and is written as the item's last parts in this order, so the prose it interrupts resumes its own part (MA4's Baxter Building, six keys on printed 76-77)
statted_pages   a code-grids book: pages outside character_pages that stat beings inside a place's text, {page, team (the place), names, partial: [[NAME, Karma]] for a grid printing only R, I and P}
teams (code-grids) [printed page, first entry's header, team] in book order: each starts a run of that team
team_names      a roster-book book: {team as its banner prints it: the team its cards file under}; an entry under no banner files under the book's title

split_heads     a roster-book book: [part, printed page, first line's end, second line's start] for a run-in head broken over two lines after a hyphen of its own, joined to one line with the hyphen kept (scripts/msh/rosterbook.py); each found exactly once

credits         a roster-book book: the first words of the module's credits and trademark list, set in a column of its last page; scripts/msh/rosterbook.parse drops the text from that line to the foot of the column (MHSP2)

layout cover-panels for MH1's: MHSP1's blocks on a loose cover's inside panels and a few booklet pages, with one-line grids in the chapters (scripts/msh/coverpanels.py). It reads character_ranges and opponents in ME1's form, and:
panels          a cover-panels book: parts (offset null, no printed page) read whole for cards; a card there cites the panel
cards           a cover-panels book: [part, printed page or null, name] for every full block, read off the page images; with opponents, the checklist
not_characters  a cover-panels book: card headers that are not characters (a vehicle), dropped
no_health       a cover-panels book: opponents whose one-line grid prints no Health; scripts/msh/npcs.py gives each F+A+S+E, flagged health_derived

no_karma        a cover-panels book: opponents whose one-line grid prints no Karma and a ruling derives it; scripts/msh/npcs.py gives each R+I+P, flagged karma_derived (MH2's Kang's Minions), or whose full block prints the word none (MH3's Miss Locke and Mr. Chambers). Absent, an unprinted Karma stays null
teams (cover-panels) {team: [names]}: a character named there is that team's; every other files under the book's title
faint_rules     a cover-panels book: [part, printed page, y in TSV pixels]: a rule between two cards that booklet.rules() cannot see (a dashed one)
drop_above      a cover-panels book: [part, printed page, y in TSV pixels]: text above y on that page is not a card's (the Epilog over Magneto's)
drop_corner     a cover-panels book: [part, printed page, x, y in TSV pixels]: every word right of x and below y on that page is not a card's (MH2's PROOF OF PURCHASE coupon)

opponent_names  a cover-panels book: "title" where a one-line grid's name is in title case, alone on the line above it (MH2's "Aliens (humanoid)"); its run-in powers after the Powers: line are read as a card's are. Absent, MH1's capitals
form_grids      a cover-panels book: [{part, page, entry, label}]: a one-line grid with no name above it that is a second block on that card (MH2's Mimic, once he has copied the Avengers' powers)

opponent_powers a cover-panels book: "run-in" where a one-line grid's Powers: line is followed by run-in powers in capitals (MH3's "WEAPONS: Each tower", "FLIGHT is at good speed."), read as its powers, going on at the top of the next column on a run-in line; a stat line opening a bracket it does not close keeps its number and sends the bracket to prose. Absent, MH1's
drop_lines      a cover-panels book: [part, printed page or null, text]: a line that is no card's text, matched once whole (MH3's In Loving Memory banner over Doom's card)

lost_headers    a cover-panels book: [part, printed page or null, identity line, NAME]: a card header no word of the TSV holds (MH3's Human Torch); a header line with the name goes in above that identity line

moves           a cover-panels book: [part, printed page, col, y from, y to, after col, after y in TSV pixels]: the lines of that column between those heights go on after the last line of the other column ending above that height (MH3's Super-Adaptoid, its text set round its portrait)
card_grids      a cover-panels book: [{part, page or null, entry, label}]: a one-line grid inside that card's text, a second block on it with that label (MH3's She-Hulk and Thing, their human forms)

prose_cards     a cover-panels book: [{part, page, name}]: a full block set inside a chapter's prose (MH4's Kingpin, printed 5), headed by its name in title case on a line of its own, which the header test does not take; read as a card from that line to the next header or one-line grid

unnamed_grids   a cover-panels book: [{part, page, name}], in page order: a one-line grid with no name line above it that is a character of its own, named by what the page's prose calls it (MH4's Reggie and Cyber-Sergeants). form_grids is for one that is a form of a card

split_headers   a cover-panels book: [part, printed page or null, as read, NAME]: a card header Tesseract read as two words (MH4's TASKMASTE R, split at the trademark sign), matched once by its cleaned text and joined

repeat_grids    a cover-panels book: [{part, page, name, of}]: a one-line grid that repeats another entry's grid (MH4's 2 Minions on printed 12 and 13, Modok's Minions'); scripts/msh/coverpanels.py checks its codes, Health and Karma against that entry's and it is not an entry (survey mh4.md decision 6)

section_labels (cover-panels) a label beyond Powers, Talents and Background is a section too (MH4's Important People and Equipment), keyed in lower case with underscores (important_people); a run-in under Equipment is read as a power is and carries section: equipment. A count before a one-line grid's name (2 Panthers) and a Special: value on its Health line (Health: 60 Special: Claws, the Special a power named as printed) are read without a field

panel_foot      a cover-panels book: true where a panel's columns run below the foot a folio page keeps (95.5% of the height), so scripts/msh/coverpanels.py reads the lines there too (MH4; MH1-3 print nothing there)

card_names      {name the card would be built with: card name}: scripts/msh/npcs.py names that card, and its id and its version's id follow the new name; for two books' different people who print one name (MA1's and MH1's Ariel, Nate 2026-10-21). Each must find exactly one entry with no parenthesis in its header. Absent, a card is named as built

MH5's mends (cover-panels, each its own _note in the mh5 entry): panel_head true (a header boxed above the 3% head band booklet.stream_of keeps for a page with a running head put before the first line of its column, by scripts/msh/coverpanels.head_lines); cut_grids [{part, page, entry, name}] (a grid set inside another card's power taken out of that card with the sentence under it, the card skipping to its next run-in or section, and read as the unnamed_grids entry of that name; MH7's text: card makes the lines the card skips the grid's prose; by coverpanels.read_cards); round_alternates true (a row's alternate rank printed in round brackets, on the line under the row or opened after the rank and wrapped, read as the row's alternate, by coverpanels.round_alternates); powers_prose [card name] (a card whose Powers: is a sentence naming no power, exempt by name from the check that a Powers: section with text has a run-in power, by coverpanels.coverage); second_reason [card name] (a block printing Reason: a second time where Resources belongs, that value read as its Resources and the label kept as printed, by coverpanels.second_reason); inner_runins [{entry, power, heads}] (colon run-ins kept inside that power's text, not powers of their own, by coverpanels.read_cards); speck_lines [part, printed page, as read, as printed] (a line on which a speck of the scan reads as a mark, matched once whole and replaced, by coverpanels.mend, and in a grid-booklets book by scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of); power_form_sets [{part, entry, intro, sets}] (the sets of form ranks after a power's intro label read as that power's text, a line each, never as a block, the run-ins after them as powers; the build stops on a count other than sets; by coverpanels.read_cards)

MH6's mends (cover-panels; carried_grids has its _note in the mh6 entry, and the other five are described by their comments in scripts/msh/coverpanels.py): foot_baseline true (a line straddling the foot, its words below the cut put on the end of the line they share a baseline with and the line rebuilt from its words by x, by coverpanels.foot_lines; absent, such a line stops the build); story_runins true (a run-in of the card's own name and Story. (Thor's Story.) opens the card's background, by coverpanels.read_cards); health_labels true (any label on a one-line grid's Health line, Flame Breath: In, read off it as the grid's one power, its rank the power's text, by coverpanels.opponents and line_block); code_row_letters true (a letter row Tesseract could not read, over seven words each a rank code the registry spells and then a Health: line, read as the letter row, each letter at its code's x, by coverpanels.code_row_letters; MH9 sets it too); lost_values [part, page or null, card, label, value] (a value printed on art that neither the TSV nor the block's crop reads, as read off the page image; an error once the value reads, or if no block takes it; by coverpanels.read_cards and parse); carried_grids [{part, page, name, codes, health, label}] (named grids under a printed pattern the OCR does not read, their codes and Health carried as read by eye, each an opponent entry with no prose, by coverpanels.parse)

MH7's mends (cover-panels, each its own _note in the mh7 entry; it sets MH5's panel_head, cut_grids and speck_lines too): plain_headers [part, page, NAME] (a capitals line right over a Fighting: row that prints no trademark sign made the card's header; the reader stops if it is not found once, or would be a header without the field; by coverpanels.mend); health_equals [part, page] (Health = n read as Health: n, a bracket after it kept as the grid's prose; it stops on a page printing no such line or two; by coverpanels.mend); grid_ink_dashes [part, page, name] (the ink under each letter of a one-line grid whose code reads as no rank measured: one short level bar is a dash, the rank left unset as printed, and anything else stops the reader; by coverpanels.ink_dashes through opponents); section_keys {label as printed: section key} (a label keyed as a section npcs.py writes, Equipment/Possessions as equipment; coverpanels.read_cards stops on a key npcs.py does not write; MH8 and MH9 set it too); runin_heads [part, page or null, HEAD] (a line opening with that head read as a run-in power, whatever the line before it ends with; the reader stops if the head is found as no power; by coverpanels.read_cards)

MH8's mends (cover-panels, each its own _note in the mh8 entry): status_headers [part, page, NAME, status] (a header followed by a lower-case status, SWORDSMAN; dead, made the card's header and the status kept as its prose; it stops if the line is not found once; by coverpanels.mend); named_headers [part, page, name as printed] (a mixed-case header with no trademark sign and an identity line before its Fighting: row made the card's header, by coverpanels.mend); column_blocks [{part, page, header, names}] (one block printing two values on every row under a line of names rewritten as one card per name, each held to a crop of its own column, by coverpanels.column_block through read_cards); identity_to_block true (every line from the header to the block kept as the identity, not two with the rest sent to the prose, by coverpanels.read_cards; npcs.py moves an identity of three lines or more into the prose row); lower_labels [part, page, Label] (the one line on the page opening with that stat label in lower case given its capital back; it stops if none is found; by coverpanels.mend)

MH9's mends (cover-panels, each its own _note in the mh9 entry; it sets MH5's powers_prose and speck_lines, MH6's code_row_letters and MH7's section_keys too): page_foot a fraction (the share of the page height read down to, in place of booklet.stream_of's 95.5%, by coverpanels.stream); joined_lines [part, page, first line, second line] (a value wrapped onto a line of its own joined back onto its row, so the block does not end there, by coverpanels.mend); page_names [part, page, NAME, card name] (a name printed on more than one card, each card named by its page, by coverpanels.read_cards and npcs.py); grid_cards [part, page, NAME] (a card whose one block is an F A S E R I P grid under its header and identity lines, by coverpanels.read_cards and coverage; in a grid-booklets book [part, page, host, n, name], the host's nth grid an entry of its own while the text stays the host's, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.parse and coverage, MLA1); split_blocks [part, page, card name] (a block whose rows go on at the top of the next column, read as one, by coverpanels.read_cards); prefer_text [part, page, card, label] or with a fifth item, the value as printed (a value the block's crop misreads taken from the page TSV, or as printed where the TSV lacks it too; an error where an entry changes nothing; booklet.prefer, through coverpanels.read_cards and parse); no_block_headers [part, page, NAME] (a header and identity lines with no block: no card, by coverpanels.parse); rows_printed [labels] (the labels every full block must hold a value for, so a row the stream cut short cannot read as None and pass, by coverpanels.coverage)
grid_headers (grid-booklets) [{part, page, health, name}] for a character header the OCR lost (ME2's BALDER): a line with the name goes in above the grid printing that Health

one_line_grids  a grid-booklets book: one-line grids (letters, numbers, codes, then Health and Karma; ME2), in reading order per page: {part, page, name} for a character of its own with no header (the chapter's prose names it), or {part, page, entry, label} for a form inside that entry. teams may be left out until they are decided; an entry then has none

second_blocks   a grid-booklets book: [{part, page, name, label}]: a one_line_grids character that is a second block on the card of that name in another booklet (ME2's Titans and Zeus in Hades), labelled, its run-in powers going to D1 as the card's (scripts/msh/npcs.py)

count_headers   a grid-booklets book: [part, page, header]: a header whose parenthesis counts the beings an encounter fields (MT2's Average Rifleman (2)), so scripts/msh/npcs.py gives the version no label. Each must find exactly one entry

bracket_identity a grid-booklets book: [part, page, header, identity]: a card header whose parenthesis is the character's given name on a card printing no real-name line (MLBA1's Rusty (Russell) Collins), so scripts/msh/npcs.py gives the version no label and the identity as written. Each must find exactly one entry with a parenthesis and no identity

short_identity  a grid-booklets book: [part, page, header, identity]: a card whose identity line is a sentence, not a name (MLA3's Colossal Deathlok), so scripts/msh/npcs.py commits only the name as written, which must be words of that line, and sends the line to D1 with the prose. Each must find exactly one entry with an identity line

bracket_names   a grid-booklets book: [part, page, header]: a card header whose parenthesis is part of the name (MSL1's Angel (Clone)), so scripts/msh/npcs.py keeps it in the card's name and id and gives the version no label. Each must find exactly one entry with a parenthesis

rank_ranges     true: scripts/msh/roster.py's check passes a number anywhere inside its rank's range (apps/marvel-heroes/data/ranks.json min and max), not only the standard number (ME2, Nate 2026-10-21). Absent, a number must be its rank's standard or an override must say why

MX1's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the mx1 entry): card_headers true (a line above a grid that is one of cards is its header, title case or not, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.parse); column_left_quantile n (the percentile of line starts taken as a column's left edge; absent, 10; by gridbooks.stream_of); letters_marks true (a one-line grid's letters row may carry a mark of up to three characters for a letter, by gridbooks.line_grids); extra_titles [part, page, title] (printed titles that are no character and that the Contents does not list, each ending the entry before it, by gridbooks.mark_titles); art_boxes [part, page, x0, y0, x1, y1] (an illustration's box in the cache's TSV pixels, whose lettering and linework the OCR reads as words, dropped from the stream, by gridbooks.stream_of); art_box_edge true (an art box whose right edge falls inside a column makes that edge the left of the lines beside it, and cuts a word there boxed over twice the body height to the body height, by gridbooks.stream_of); bullet_marks [signs] (a list's bullet read at a line's start, before a lower-case word, as one of these, dropped, by gridbooks.stream_of); talents_end [part, page, entry, talents] (a codes-only grid's TALENT: or TALENTS: line kept as its talents alone, the lines after it the type's prose, by gridbooks.parse)

ME3's grid mends (grid-booklets, each true, each its own _note in the me3 entry): health_below, popularity_below, grids_end_at_p, code_first_rows, class_mark, trailing_marks, popularity_notes; with two_line_headers [part, page, first line, second line as read], header_blocks [part, page, header as read] (a header over a second grid of the entry above), a one_line_grids grid's wrapped (its letters and codes set on two lines each) and a grid_headers health_printed (the Health as the line reads it, 20,000)

ME3's check (grid-booklets, its own _note in the me3 entry): popularity_numbers true (scripts/msh/gridbooks.coverage holds every grid printing Resources to a Popularity that reads as a number, a sign or dash before it and at most a bracket opening with a number; the check that turns popularity_below or popularity_notes red when off; MX3 sets it too)

MT2's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the mt2 entry): code_first_caps true (a row printing the rank code in capitals before the number, bare or bracketed, F RM 30 and F GD (10), turned round, by scripts/msh/roster.rows_from; slash_forms, row_marks and MT3's slash_title_case, two_ranks and spaced_marks act only under it); row_marks true (marks a crop's re-read hangs round a capital code stripped, and FY read as TY, by roster.rows_from); bracket_tail true (an underscore and a mark after a closing bracket stripped, by roster.secondary); slash_forms [{part, page, entry, labels}] (a block printing two forms on each row and two Healths, split by a slash, made two blocks with those labels; the build stops unless the entry has one block, every row an alternate and two Healths; by roster.rows_from, scripts/msh/gridbooks.slash_forms and npcs.py); not_labels [labels] (capital lines never taken for a block's label, cleared by gridbooks.parse, which stops if no block carries one); stop_labels [part, page, label] (a run-in printed with a full stop for its colon read as that label, opening its section; each found exactly once on its page; by gridbooks.stream_of); lost_letters true (a one-line grid whose letters line left the stream started at its seven-token row with a Health line within two lines under it, on a page one_line_grids names, by gridbooks.line_grids); health_sentence true (a form's Health and Karma printed in a sentence under its grid taken from that sentence, which stays in the text, by gridbooks.read_line_grid through line_grids); indented_power_heads [part, page, power name] (a power set indented like the chapter's paragraphs marked a power head, so roster.read_entries starts a power there and not the chapter; each found exactly once on its page; by gridbooks.stream_of); opponent_section_labels {run-in label: section} (a run-in in a chapter's block that opens that section instead of ending the entry, by gridbooks.parse)

MT3's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the mt3 entry; it sets MT2's code_first_caps, slash_forms, letters_marks and lost_letters too): class_i_digit true (a Class rank's 1 read as i in a one-line grid's codes row, Cli000, read as Cl1000, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.read_line_grid); code_marks true (marks hung in a one-line grid's codes row dropped, by gridbooks.line_codes); derived_totals true (a one-line grid printing no Health or no Karma: one printing neither ended at its codes row, and a missing total derived from the rows, F+A+S+E or R+I+P, and listed in the block's derived, by gridbooks.read_line_grid and line_grids; npcs.py flags such a card health_derived or karma_derived); mid_page_tops [part, page] (a Contents break set partway down its page placed at the title's own line, not the page's top, by gridbooks.mark_breaks); entry_ends [part, page, the whole line as read] (a sidebar or box in an entry's column that the entry's text does not include, ending the entry there; each on one line of its page, found once; by gridbooks.stream_of and roster.read_entries); slash_title_case true (under slash_forms, the second form's code read in title case as well as capitals); spaced_marks true (under code_first_caps, marks between a capital code and its number set off by spaces); two_ranks true (under code_first_caps, a row printing two ranks, codes then numbers each split by a slash, read as the rank and its alternate); res_label true (Res: read as Resources on a grid of one form); split_grids true (a grid broken across a column read to its Popularity line in the next column, by roster.grid_at); the four before split_grids each by scripts/msh/roster.rows_from

MX2's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the mx2 entry): subhead_exact_case, code_rows_resources_below (with code_rows) and line_grid_resources, each true; table_grids [{part, page, first, names, health, karma}] (a table of named rows of codes under one Health and Karma, each name a card of its own, read by scripts/msh/gridbooks.table_grids from a --psm 6 crop); and a one_line_grids grid's karma (with its health, ties a name to one grid where a page prints that Health twice) and subhead_page (the page its subhead is on, where not the grid's); line_identity [{part, page, name, lines}] (a codes-only grid's identity lines as printed, which scripts/msh/npcs.py makes the card's identity where its prose as read is those words alone)

MX3's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the mx3 entry): unread_codes, code_row_specks and code_rows_end_at_popularity, each true and read with code_rows (scripts/msh/codegrids.code_row and grid_at, through scripts/msh/gridbooks.grid); label_line_powers [part, page, power name] (a power set on its section label's line, cut to a line of its own by scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of); override_values true (scripts/msh/gridbooks.coverage holds each override's printed values to the block as read)

MX4's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the mx4 entry): identity_lines n (a header looked for n+1 lines above its grid and n identity lines kept, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.mark_headers and scripts/msh/roster.read_entries; absent, three) and wrapped_alternates true (a bracketed alternate wrapped onto the next line of a grid crop joined back onto its row, by scripts/msh/roster.rows_from)

MLA1's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the mla1 entry): body_top n (the share of the page height above which scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of drops words; absent, 0.10); derived_karma, dash_shift_codes, dash_marks, code_grids_by_pitch and inner_grids, each true (a vertical grid printing no Karma derives it as R+I+P and lists it in the block's derived, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.parse; Sh-0 read as a code-first row's Shift 0, by scripts/msh/codegrids.code_row; a dash hard against a total stripped, by scripts/msh/roster.secondary; a code-first grid with no Popularity, or no Karma either, read from a crop seven row pitches down, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.grid, in place of grids_end_at_p; the text after a second grid set inside a card's section kept in that section, by scripts/msh/roster.read_entries); karma_grids [part, page, name] (a grid of R, I and P alone with Karma beside R, anchored at its Karma line and named, F, A, S and E null, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.karma_grids); label_powers [part, page, label] (a title-case label under KNOWN POWERS: left a power by scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of rather than raised by title_case_labels to open a section; each found once)

MLBA1's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the mlba1 entry, the five total mends sharing its grid_mends_note): subhead_caps true (a bold title-case subhead given its colon by subhead_labels is raised to the capitals roster.RUN_IN and roster.SECTION read, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of); word_rows and split_word_rows, each true (seven full-word rows with Health, Karma, Resources and Popularity as four lines under the grid rewritten into code-first rows with the totals beside F, S, R and P; and a grid broken across a column skipping up to four lines that are no row where the column changes; by scripts/msh/gridbooks.word_rows); low_grids [part, page, header as read] (a grid whose row letters the stream reads sideways, read from a crop from the header's foot to the Karma line, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.low_grids; each header one line of its page with seven rows in its crop); welded_codes, semicolon_labels, card_art, popularity_minus and one_as_i, each true (a code welded to its number split; Health; and Karma; read as labels; a card portrait's marks read after a row or a total dropped; a minus read as U+FFFD, a dash or a spaced hyphen; an i read as a 1 in a number; by scripts/msh/gridbooks.total_mends and mend_reader); page_bottoms [part, page, fraction of the page height] (a page whose text runs below the 93.5% every other page ends at), powers_open [part, page, the first power's name] (a run-in that opens a powers section where no Known Powers label prints) and banner_bands [part, page, y in TSV pixels] (a band above a page-wide banner read column by column before the band under it), each by scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of

MLA2's grid mends (grid-booklets, each true, each its own _note in the mla2 entry): bracketed_card_names (a card name with a variant in brackets also matched with the bracket gone, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.forms, match and coverage); undashed_shift_zero (Sh0 printed with no dash, read Sho, ShO or Sh0O, a code folded to Sh0, by scripts/msh/codegrids.code_row and code_of), code_rank_aliases (the rank_aliases spellings roster.canon cannot read taken as codes of a code-first row, by codegrids.code_row and code_of) and s_before_number (a number read with an S before a digit, the S dropped, by codegrids.code_row and number_of); rising_row_pitch (a by-pitch grid whose least line gap cuts its rows tried again at larger pitches, the first crop giving seven rows winning, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.grid); mend_by_health (where F+A+S+E misses the Health and exactly one unmended 8-for-3 or 8-for-5 reading of F, A, S or E makes it, that reading taken, by scripts/msh/codegrids.mend_by_health through rows_from); power_heads_not_run_ins (a line power_heads names never taken as a run-in) and opponent_grid_ends (an indented line right under a chapter opponent's grid ends the opponent), each by scripts/msh/roster.read_entries

MLA3's grid mends (grid-booklets, each true, each its own _note in the mla3 entry): upper_shift_zero (undashed_shift_zero's fold made in any case, so SH-O reads Shift 0; read only with undashed_shift_zero, by scripts/msh/codegrids.code_of through scripts/msh/gridbooks.grid); stream_row_fallback (where no crop of a by-pitch grid gives seven rows, the stream's own lines over seven of the first pitch read as the rows, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.grid); totals_checked (every block's Health and Karma must have been held to its rows, unless an override or an unprinted total explains that field, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.coverage)

MSL1's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the msl1 entry): codes_over_numbers, resources_beside_health and line_popularity_minus, each true (a one-line grid's codes row printed above its numbers row read as each code over its number, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.read_line_grid; Health beside Resources over Karma beside Popularity read as the roster's Health and Karma over Resources and Popularity; MLBA1's popularity_minus applied to a grid's Resources line; each through scripts/msh/gridbooks.line_grids); split_labels [part, page, first line's end, second line's start] (a label hyphenated over two lines made one label on the second; each found exactly once), identity_background [labels] (a BACKGROUND section opened at the first of these labels after KNOWN POWERS) and mid_runins [part, page, label as read] (a run-in label set after a sentence on the same line started on a line of its own; each found exactly once on its page), each by scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of

MSL2's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the msl2 entry): short_number_rows [part, page, the numbers row as read] (a numbers row printing fewer numbers than its codes, read as printed with each row it does not reach null; the row must match whole; by scripts/msh/gridbooks.read_line_grid through line_grids); form_resources true (a form's one_line_grids grid, named by entry and label, keeping its own Resources and Popularity lines on its block, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.line_grids); subhead_line_powers [part, page, power name] (KNOWN POWERS printed with no colon and run into the first power on its line cut into the label, given its colon, and the power; each found exactly once on its page; by scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of)

MSL3's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the msl3 entry): equals_labels and no_karma_line, each true (Health = n Karma = n read as the roster's Health: n Karma: n on a page one_line_grids names; a grid printing a Health line and no Karma line keeping its Karma null; by scripts/msh/gridbooks.line_grids); text_health [part, page, the Health as printed] (a Health printed as words kept as printed, its grid read as if the line printed a number and the line anchoring its block, by scripts/msh/gridbooks.read_line_grid and scripts/msh/roster.read_entries); run_on_prose true (in an opponent_indented_paragraphs entry, an indented paragraph after a power's sentence kept as the entry's prose, not the last power's text, by scripts/msh/roster.read_entries); bracket_given_names [part, page, header] (a header whose parenthesis is the being's own name and the rest its kind, so scripts/msh/npcs.py names the card by the parenthesis and makes the rest its identity line; each must find exactly one entry with a parenthesis and no identity)

MSL4's grid mends (grid-booklets, each its own _note in the msl4 entry): repeated_power_heads [part, page, power name, how many] (a power on more than one card of a page, which power_heads cannot name: every line of the page that starts with the name and a colon is a head, and there must be exactly that many) and heads_in_text [part, page, power name, how many] (such a name printed at a line's start with its colon where it is text and stays text; any other line of the part starting with it that is not a named head stops the build; exactly that many must be found), each by scripts/msh/gridbooks.stream_of; role_brackets [part, page, header, card name] (a header whose parenthesis is a role or a kind, not a name or a version, dropped, so scripts/msh/npcs.py names the card by the registry and gives its version no label; each must find exactly one entry with a parenthesis and no name of its own)
The cache is under WORKSHOP_MSH_CACHE (default .cache/msh), never committed. The survey is apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/<slug>.md.

me3.grids_end_at_p_note: Seven Resource Book grids print no Resources and no Popularity (Mephisto's second grid 6, the Thralls and Footsoldiers 7, Pluto's Footsoldiers 9, Dormammu's second grid 12, the Mindless Ones and the Dark Dimension Inhabitant 14); gridbooks.grid ends such a grid at its P row (survey me3.md, item 4).
me3.code_first_rows_note: Charon (Adventure p.24) and Pluto's Footsoldiers (Resource p.9) print each row's code before its number (F Am 50); roster.rows_from turns such a row round (survey me3.md, item 5).
me3.class_mark_note: Dormammu's E (Resource p.12) reads with a mark of the art before its Class code; roster.rows_from allows one mark there, as ME2's CIl5000 mend allows none (survey me3.md, item 6).
me3.trailing_marks_note: Art beside a grid reads as a mark after a number (Captain Marvel's Karma, Resource p.15; the Mindless Ones' Health, p.14); roster.secondary strips a trailing mark and what follows it, a mark before a number and what follows a closing bracket (Captain Marvel's Popularity and Resources, printed 55 and Pr(4), read on the page image; survey me3.md, item 7).
me3.popularity_notes_note: A bracketed note set right under Mephisto's (Resource p.6) and Pluto's (p.8) grids is not the rest of the Popularity, which a wrapped one is (Gladiator's, Adventure p.3, opening with a number); roster.secondary leaves a bracketed line that opens with a word to the entry's text (survey me3.md, item 8).
me3.popularity_numbers_note: The check behind popularity_below and popularity_notes (plan row 5b, 2026-10-30): gridbooks.coverage holds every grid that prints Resources to a Popularity that reads as a number, a sign or dash before it and at most a bracket opening with a number. Either mend turned off reads a Popularity as nothing or with the note joined, and turns roster.py red. A field of its own because ME1 and ME2 print words in one.
me3.two_line_headers_note: Headers set on two lines, as read, joined to one line by gridbooks.stream_of: mark_headers marks only the line nearest the grid. Read on the page images 2026-10-30 (survey me3.md, item 10). Not taken: a rule joining any capital line right above a header, which would have to be proved on every earlier book.
me3.header_blocks_note: Not MA4's block_labels (a code-grids field of another shape). A header over a second grid of the entry above it (Resource p.6): the grid becomes a block of Mephisto's labelled with the header, and the powers under it are his (survey me3.md, item 11 and decision 5). Dormammu's second grid (p.12) prints no header and lands on his entry already; its label is a label override in me3-overrides.json.
me3.card_names_note: Survey me3.md decision 6 (recommended, applied unanswered; Nate 2026-10-30), by Nate's ruling on MA1's and MH1's Ariel (2026-10-21) that each card's name says which person: this book's Captain Marvel is Mar-Vell of the Kree (Resource p.15, his identity line), not the Monica Rambeau of MHSP1, MH2 and MHSP2. Only this card is renamed here: the decision's other half, the three Monica Rambeau cards as Captain Marvel (Monica Rambeau), changes three earlier books' ids and D1 keys, and is not this row's.
me3.speck_lines_note: [part, printed page, as read, as printed], gridbooks.stream_of (MX1's and MH9's shape), each read on a crop of the page image 2026-10-30 (plan row 6a). Resource p.6, column 2: a speck after the bracket closing Enchantment's Galactus note is read as a brace. p.7 and p.9: the headers' apostrophes are read as U+2019, and are given in ASCII as every other book's card names are (Galactus's "Cat", Kang's Minions). p.9, column 2: Hela's power Illusion-Casting, read Iilusion.
me3.power_heads_note: [part, printed page, power name]: a run-in power whose line above ends no sentence, so roster.read_entries would read it as the power above's text; gridbooks.stream_of marks the line as a power head, and each must be found exactly once. Adventure p.4, Firelord's Energy Sheath: after a list of Energy Conversion's forms, each a line with no stop (Thermal Control). Resource p.6, Mephisto's Enlargement and Power Control, and p.8, Pluto's Mystical Flame: after a bracketed Galactus note that ends on the bracket (Galactus.] and Galactus]). ME2's Pluto card has Mystical Flame. Read on the page images 2026-10-30 (plan row 6a).

reference_summary.note: The Pregenerated Heroes Summary, printed sideways. Transcribed by eye 2026-10-30 (plan row 4b) from a render turned 90 degrees; Tesseract reads the page sideways. Every value and power name agrees with ME2's chart, row for row, Firelord's Karma 90 included: his ranks give 110, and his block (Adventure p.4) prints 110. Power names are the chart's, with its abbreviations spelled out and each power's own rank where it prints one; a power the chart qualifies at length keeps its name only. Its team is decision 1's (teams_note).

mt2.offset_evidence: 2026-10-30, scripts/msh/survey.py tsv_folio: 43 pages vote printed = PDF - 2 and none disagrees inside the booklet. Twenty more booklet pages print their folio (PDF - 2) on the page image, read on a strip of each page's foot, Tesseract missing it: PDF 4-11, 18, 20, 25, 31, 36, 41, 43, 46, 47, 48, 52 and 53. PDF 3 is printed 1, the title page with the Contents and the credits, which prints no folio. So PDF 3-66 are the 64-page booklet (594 x 767 pt), printed 1-64, every page but the title page with a folio. PDF 2 and 67 are booklet-sized (594 x 767 pt) with no folio: PDF 2 prints the Krozzar Camp map, a battle flowchart for the Krozzar assault and the Research Shack map; PDF 67 the Chronovore's Brain map and a Chronovore encounters chart. PDF 1 and 68 are the outside of the cover (600 x 775 pt; PDF 68 prints the product code 6886 and calls the module the second of the three-part Time Warp series). PDF 69 and 70 (1470 x 1134 pt) are the Players' Map and the Judge's Map, Dodge City and its surroundings; PDF 70 prints the product code 6886XXX0701, and its vote of 1 (k = 69) is a digit on the map, no folio. None of PDF 1, 2 and 67-70 prints a folio or a stat block. Survey mt2.md, The scan and Offset.
mt2.stat_labels_note: Two block shapes, each printing Health:, Karma:, Resources: and Popularity: as labels to the right of the rank rows, on rows F, S, R and P. The Player and Non-Player Characters (printed 3-8) print the labels in plain type; Moon Knight (printed 4) abbreviates Resources to Res:, the only block read that does. The Western Heroes (printed 52-63) set the labels in bold under a STATISTICS label. Of the one-line grids read, Lobo's (printed 57) prints Health: and Karma: on lines under its codes, Hamilton Slade's (printed 53) gives both in a sentence, and Black Knight's flying horse (printed 8) prints neither. Read on the page images 2026-10-30. In the chapters (plan row 7b): the four one-line grids (printed 12, 21, 24, 33) print Health: and Karma: on lines under their codes; the four named blocks (28, 29 twice, 36) print all four labels to the right of rows F, S, R and P, Resources as TY (5) and FE (2) with a space before the bracket, or a bare 0.
mt2.section_labels_note: Counted on the OCR of printed 3-8 and 52-64 and read on the page images of printed 4, 6, 8 and 52 (2026-10-30). The Player and Non-Player Characters' blocks (printed 3-8) print KNOWN POWERS: in capitals (9 of 13 blocks; Einstein, Alexander, Napoleon and Genghis Khan print none) and Talents: (11), Contacts: (2) and Background: (13) as bold run-ins; the Sandman (printed 7) adds Weaknesses:, and the Vision (printed 3-4) a NOTE: run-in after his background. The Western Heroes (printed 52-64) print STATISTICS, BACKGROUND, KNOWN POWERS, ADDITIONAL NOTES: and ROLE-PLAYING NOTES as capital subheads in that order, eight times each, with Talents: and Contacts: as run-ins under KNOWN POWERS, and HISTORY as a ruled head across the columns. BACKGROUND holds ten identity run-ins: Real Name, Occupation, Legal Status, Identity, Place of Birth, Marital Status, Known Relatives, Base of Operations, Past Group Affiliation(s) and Present Group Affiliation(s), the last two printed both with and without the s. The chapters' four named blocks (plan row 7b, read on the page images of printed 28, 29 and 36): the Hobart Gang's three print KNOWN POWERS:, Talents:, Background: and Role Playing Notes:, the last a bold run-in printed 3-8 does not have; the Twain android's prints KNOWN POWERS:, then Talents. and Contacts. with a full stop.
mt2.rank_aliases_note: The labelled blocks of both character sections print two-letter codes in capitals: PR, TY, GD, EX, RM, IN, AM and MN (the Sandman's Endurance, printed 7) on printed 3-8, and FE on Lobo's codes-only grid (printed 57). The one-line grid inside Black Knight's block (printed 8) prints its codes in title case (Gd, Ex, Rm, In, Ty), and so do the chapters' grids in the OCR of printed 12, 21 and 33 (Fe, Pr, Ty, Gd, Ex, Rm, In, Un). Read on the page images 2026-10-30. No book-specific spelling (MA4's RE, MH9's GO) is in the two character sections; one code is misprinted (Genghis Khan's GD for TY, printed 6, survey mt2.md Stat blocks). The chapters' eight blocks (plan row 7b, read on the page images 2026-10-30) print no code outside these: the one-line grids Rm, Gd, In, Un, Fe, Ty, Pr and Ex, the named blocks RM, GD, TY, EX, PR and FE (the Twain android's Resources, printed 36).

mt2.contents_note: The printed Contents (printed 1), each entry then checked against its banner or header on the page, 2026-10-30. Every one agrees with its page, so there are no contents_errata: the INTRODUCTION banner (printed 2); The Player Characters (3, column 3) with THE VISION (3), MOON KNIGHT (4) and THE SCARLET WITCH (5); Non-Player Characters and Friendly NPCs (5, column 3) and Enemy NPCs (6, column 1); the 28 chapter banners, each a white-on-black bar across the page, on printed 9, 11 (2 at the top, 3 mid-page), 12 (4, mid-page), 13 (5, mid-page), 15, 17, 18, 19 (9, mid-page), 21, 22, 26, 28, 30, 31 (15 at the top, 16 mid-page), 32, 33, 34, 35, 36 (21, mid-page), 38, 39, 41, 42, 45, 46 and 47, every other one at the top of its page; and the WESTERN HEROES banner (printed 52) with its eight hero headers on the Contents' pages. Tesseract drops the title after the colon of six banners (Chapters 10, 15, 16, 17, 24 and 26), each read on the page image. The book prints no index. One banner is not in the Contents: Event Cards, on printed 49 and 50 (a page of captioned cards and a page of pictured cards, no character); Chapter 28 runs on printed 47-48 and resumes on printed 51 (its AFTERMATH and KARMA). Survey mt2.md, The book's own authority lists.
mt2.columns_note: Three columns on every booklet page read (printed 3-8, the chapter openings of printed 9, 11, 12, 13, 19, 31, 36, 39 and 47, and the Western Heroes' text pages printed 55, 58, 60, 62 and 64), a block's rank rows and labels as two sub-columns of one column. Printed 52 sets Ghost Rider I & II's block in column 1 beside a portrait two columns wide, with HISTORY in three columns under both. Event Cards (printed 49-50) are a three by five grid of cards. Read on the page images 2026-10-30.
mt2.panels_note: No page outside the booklet prints a stat block: the OCR of PDF 1, 2 and 67-70 holds no Health, Karma or rank row, and their images show the cover, the back cover's blurb and four maps. The scan holds no cover-panel card. Survey mt2.md, Cover-panel cards.
mt2.character_ranges_note: The card pages, read on the page images 2026-10-30 (plan rows 7a and 7b): the Player and Non-Player Characters on printed 3-8 (The Player Characters opens in column 3 of printed 3, after the Introduction; Chapter 1's banner tops printed 9), 13 labelled blocks; and the Western Heroes on printed 52-64, 8 STATISTICS blocks on 52-63 with Two-Gun Kid's history ending on 64. Chapter pages that stat a being inside the prose are opponents, not card pages. In ME3's form (each range with its part); which reader takes them is survey mt2.md, Which reader fits.
mt2.opponents_note: Every block inside the chapters (printed 9-51), found on a 40 dpi render of every chapter page and by the OCR's rank rows, and read on the page images 2026-10-30 (plan row 7b). Four one-line grids (letters, numbers, title-case codes, then Health: and Karma: lines) with NO name line, each named here by what its prose calls it (survey mt2.md decision 3): the tyrannosaur (printed 12, column 2), the hoplites (21, column 2), the cavemen (24, column 1, top; introduced at the foot of printed 23) and Khan's champion (33, column 2). Four named blocks of the first shape (letter, CODE, number, the four labels to the right): "Faro" John Hobart (28, column 3, under the capital line THE HOBART GANG), Average Rifleman (2) and Average Mounted Desperado (3) (29, columns 1 and 2; the counts dropped from the names, decision 3), and the Twain android (36, column 3), which prints no header, only a sentence ending statistics: above its grid. Beings statted only by reference to the Judge's Book (printed 22-24, 32, 34, 35, 38, 39, 43) print no rank and are not here (decision 9).
mt2.layout_note: ME1's, ME2's and ME3's reader, scripts/msh/gridbooks.py (survey mt2.md, Which reader fits, verdict grid-booklets; measured by plan row 7c2's trial 2026-10-30, set by rows 8a to 8a3). It reads parts, character_ranges (printed 3-8 and 52-64) and opponents (the eight chapter blocks, printed 12-36) as row 7b wrote them. Every mend this book needs is a field of this entry, so no earlier book's parse moves: fields an earlier book already reads (letters_marks and one_line_grids, card_headers and cards, grid_headers, speck_lines, title_case_labels and trailing_marks: the survey's grid-booklets items 4, 7-9, 11 and 12; rank_ranges, decision 8) and MT2's own (code_first_caps, row_marks, lost_letters, health_sentence, subhead_labels, not_labels, slash_forms, a one-line grid's host, a team's fourth field, stop_labels and bracket_tail: items 1-3, 5, 6, 10 and 13-18), plus three the trial did not reach (indented_power_heads, opponent_section_labels, and opponent_indented_paragraphs with an opponent's runs_on). roster.py mt2, 2026-10-30: 34 entries, 32 blocks, 30 passing, 2 known from the overrides, 0 failing.
mt2.rank_ranges_note: Survey mt2.md decision 8 (recommended, applied unanswered; Nate 2026-10-30: take the survey's recommendations): ME2's and ME3's ruling for this book too, so the Hobart Gang's numbers (printed 28-29: "Faro" John Hobart, Average Rifleman and Average Mounted Desperado), every one inside its rank's range and none its standard, pass as printed; roster.rank_ranges hands the check each code's range. Off, those three blocks fail on all seven ranks (measured 2026-10-30). Not taken: an override per value (21 of them, plus Hobart's Resources).
mt2.card_names_note: Survey mt2.md decision 5 (recommended, applied unanswered; Nate 2026-10-30), by Nate's ruling on MA1's and MH1's Ariel (2026-10-21) that each card's name says which person, as ME3's Captain Marvel (Mar-Vell): this book's Black Knight is Nathan Garrett, not the Dane Whitman of MHSP2 and MH8. The identity line under his header prints the surname Garret, one t (printed 8, read on the page image 2026-10-30), and is kept as printed; the card's name spells it as the decision does. Only this card is renamed; the two Dane Whitman cards keep their names.
mt2.count_headers_note: [part, printed page, header]: a header whose parenthesis counts the beings the encounter fields, not a version (printed 29, read on the page image 2026-10-30). Survey mt2.md decision 3 (recommended, applied unanswered; Nate 2026-10-30): the count is dropped from the name, and npcs.py gives the version no label. Off, the two versions are labelled 2 and 3. Each must find exactly one entry with a parenthesis, or the build stops.
mt2.teams_note: [part, printed page, team], with an optional fourth field: the header the team starts at on that page, where without it a team starts at the page's top (gridbooks.team_of; survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 16). parse stops if no entry on that page has that header. Survey mt2.md decision 1 (recommended, applied unanswered; Nate 2026-10-30): Weird, Weird West Heroes for the three Player Characters (the Vision, Moon Knight and the Scarlet Witch, printed 3-5), as ME2's and ME3's pregenerated heroes; MT2 The Weird, Weird West from the Friendly NPCs header on printed 5, under the Scarlet Witch, for the Friendly and Enemy NPCs (Albert Einstein to Krozzar, printed 5-8) and the eight chapter blocks (printed 12-36); Western Heroes, the book's own banner, from printed 52 for the eight Western Heroes and Lobo (57). The Non-Player Characters banner on printed 5, above Friendly NPCs, has no block and files with the heroes. Not taken: West Coast Avengers for the Vision, the Scarlet Witch and Moon Knight, since no block of theirs prints an identity line naming it.
mt2.code_first_caps_note: Rows that print the rank code in capitals before the number, bare (F RM 30: printed 3-8, 28, 29 and 36) or bracketed (F GD (10): printed 52-63). roster.ROW wants the number first and ME3's code_first_rows turns round title-case codes only, so the stock reader left 24 of its 25 blocks unread (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets items 1 and 2). roster.rows_from turns each row round: it splits a row letter welded to its code (EIN 40), allows up to three marks or an underscore between code and number (RM_~ 30, the Vision's P, printed 3), reads an i inside the brackets as 1 (Red Wolf's R, printed 57), and a 3 read as 8 inside them where 80 is outside Remarkable's range and 30 is its number (RM(80): Ghost Rider IV's P, 53; Red Wolf's F, 57; Shooting Star's A, 59; Texas Twister's E, 61). A GridReader mend; row_marks and slash_forms act only under it. Off, slash_forms finds no second form for Moon Knight and the build stops (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.row_marks_note: Marks the crop re-read hangs round a capital code, and TY read as FY: Albert Einstein's A and E (printed 5), both TY 6 on the page image (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 3, code-grids item 10). roster.rows_from strips them and reads FY as TY, under code_first_caps. Off, Einstein's grid is unread, his Health and Karma are not numbers and roster.py exits 1 (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.slash_forms_note: [{part, printed page, entry, labels}]: Moon Knight (printed 4) prints two forms on each row, code and number, a slash, code and number, and Health 90/150. roster.rows_from reads each second value as the row's alternate and the block's Res: label as Resources, and gridbooks.slash_forms makes the one block two, labelled Normal (Health 90) and Moonlight (Health 150), each Karma 60 and each holding. The build stops unless the entry has one block, every row an alternate and two Healths. Survey mt2.md decision 6 (recommended, applied unanswered; Nate 2026-10-30): one card with two blocks, as ME3's Mephisto; grid-booklets item 14, code-grids item 12. Off, the block holds the Moonlight values in its Health and Karma, which are not numbers (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.not_labels_note: Capital lines that are never a block's label: STATISTICS, the subhead over each Western Hero's grid (printed 52-63), which roster.read_entries takes for a sub-block's name (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 13; code-grids item 4). gridbooks.parse clears it, and stops if no block carries a listed label. Off, the eight Western Heroes' blocks are labelled STATISTICS and roster.py still exits 0 (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.bracket_tail_note: An underscore and a mark after a closing bracket: the Twain android's Resources, FE (2) (printed 36), which trailing_marks' rule, a mark that is not a word character, leaves (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 18). roster.secondary strips them. Off, the Resources read FE (2) and then an underscore and a dash, and roster.py still exits 0, since no check reads Resources (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.letters_marks_note: ME2's and ME3's: a one-line grid's letters line may carry a mark of up to three characters for a letter (gridbooks.LETTERS_MARKS; survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 4). The tyrannosaur's (printed 12) reads with a section sign either side of its S. Off, lost_letters starts that grid at its row instead and the parse comes out the same (measured 2026-10-30), so the two fields cover each other there.
mt2.one_line_grids_note: Each is the seven letters F A S E R I P, a row of numbers or of rank codes, then a Health and a Karma (survey mt2.md, The chapters' grids and named blocks, and decisions 3 and 4). Four are chapter cards with no name line, named by what the prose calls them (decision 3): Tyrannosaur (printed 12), Hoplites (21), Cavemen (24) and Khan's Champion (33). Hamilton Slade (printed 53) is a block of Ghost Rider IV's card labelled with his name, as ME3's Beta Ray Bill, its Health 46 and Karma 36 read from a sentence (health_sentence). Lobo (printed 57) is a card of his own under Western Heroes, his grid codes only, on standard numbers and rank_only; his host is the card whose entry his grid sits inside (Red Wolf's KNOWN POWERS), and gridbooks.parse gives the sections and members after his grid back to Red Wolf (grid-booklets item 15, code-grids item 19). Khan's Champion's and Lobo's letters lines are lost (lost_letters). Black Knight's flying horse (printed 8) prints neither Health nor Karma and is left in his card's text (decision 4).
mt2.cards_note: The 23 headers card_headers reads (gridbooks.mark_headers: a line above a grid that is a card's name is its header, MX1's), which are the checklist too, so no roster_sections (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 7): the 22 card-page names in title case (The Vision to Krozzar, printed 3-8; Ghost Rider I & II to Two-Gun Kid, printed 52-63, Lobo among them) and "Faro" John Hobart (printed 28). Without them the real-name line under Doctor Doom, The Sandman, Mysterio, Black Knight and Scorpion (printed 6-8) became the header, STATISTICS headed each Western Hero (52-63) and THE HOBART GANG headed Hobart (28). With card_headers off, Hobart's entry is not found and the build stops (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.grid_headers_note: The Twain android (printed 36, column 3) prints no header, only a sentence above its grid; gridbooks.place_headers puts Twain Android in above the grid whose Health line reads 100 (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 8; the name is decision 3's). Off, its block is an entry with no header on no checklist and roster.py exits 1 (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.title_case_labels_note: MX1's: a title-case run-in that is one of section_labels (Talents:, Contacts:, Background:, Role Playing Notes:, printed 3-8, 28-29 and 52-63) is raised to capitals so it opens its section rather than reading as a power (gridbooks.stream_of; survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 11). Off, the Hobart Gang's Role Playing Notes stay in title case, opponent_section_labels finds none and the build stops (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.trailing_marks_note: ME3's: art beside a grid reads as a mark after a number, and roster.secondary strips a trailing mark and what follows it, a mark before a number and what follows a closing bracket. Here Ghost Rider I & II's Health (printed 52) reads 46 and a closing bracket (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 12). Off, that Health is not a number and roster.py exits 1 (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.subhead_labels_note: Section subheads printed in capitals with no colon on the Western Heroes' pages (printed 52-63): KNOWN POWERS, BACKGROUND, ROLE-PLAYING NOTES and HISTORY. gridbooks.stream_of gives such a line its colon, so it opens its section as a run-in does (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 10). ADDITIONAL NOTES is listed too but prints its colon there, so the rule leaves it to read as the run-in it is. Off, the eight Western Heroes read no powers section: powers 33 across 11 entries for 51 across 19 (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.stop_labels_note: [part, printed page, label]: a run-in printed with a full stop for its colon, the Twain android's Talents. and Contacts. (printed 36), read as TALENTS: and CONTACTS:, so each opens its section rather than reading as a power (gridbooks.stream_of; survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 17, code-grids item 17). Each must be found exactly once on its page, or the build stops. Off, the android's sections and powers move and roster.py still exits 0 (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.lost_letters_note: A one-line grid whose letters line read below confidence and left the stream: Khan's Champion (printed 33) and Lobo (57). On a page one_line_grids names, gridbooks.line_grids starts the grid at a seven-token row of numbers or codes with a Health line within two lines under it (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 5, code-grids item 14). Off, roster.py stops at one_line_grids not found: Lobo (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.health_sentence_note: A form's Health and Karma printed in a sentence under its grid, not on labelled lines: Hamilton Slade, Ghost Rider IV's form (printed 53), Health 46 = 6+10+20+10 and Karma 36 = 10+20+6, both holding. gridbooks.read_line_grid takes the two numbers from that sentence and leaves it in the entry's text (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 6, code-grids item 15). Off, roster.py stops at one_line_grids not found: Hamilton Slade (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.speck_lines_note: [part, printed page, as read, as printed], gridbooks.stream_of (MX1's and MH9's shape), each matched once whole and replaced (survey mt2.md, grid-booklets item 9). Printed 52: the header GHOST RIDER I & II, its II read as Ill (decision 11). Printed 28, column 3: Hobart's header, its opening double quote read as two asterisks and its closing one as a curly double and a curly single quote, given with straight quotes as the card name is (decision 3). Printed 36, column 3: the Twain android's power Body Armor, read Boay, which indented_power_heads must find by name; off, the build stops there (measured 2026-10-30).
mt2.indented_power_heads_note: [part, printed page, power name]: a power inside a chapter's block set indented like the chapter's paragraphs, which roster.read_entries would take for the chapter resuming: the Twain android's Body Armor and Radio Communication (printed 36, column 3). gridbooks.stream_of marks each, which must be found exactly once on its page, and read_entries starts a power there. Off, the android loses both: powers 49 across 18 entries for 51 across 19 (measured 2026-10-30). Added by plan row 8a1; not in the survey's list.
mt2.opponent_section_labels_note: {run-in label: section}, read in the chapters' blocks (opponent mode) alone, where a run-in that opens no section is the chapter resuming and ends the entry. msl4.offset_evidence: 2026-11-02, scripts/msh/survey.py tsv_folio: 4 pages vote printed = PDF - 2 (PDF 14, 22, 24 and 27) and no vote disagrees. Tesseract reads few folios because each body page sets a small folio centred under a strip of comic panels at its foot. Read on a strip of every booklet page's foot at 45 dpi (PDF 3-34): 30 pages print their folio, every one PDF - 2, from 2 (PDF 4) to 31 (PDF 33), with no outlier; two print none: the title page (printed 1, PDF 3, the Contents, the credits and the ISBN) and printed 32 (PDF 34), a whole-page advertisement for the Basic Set. So PDF 3-34 (596 x 768 pt) are the 32-page booklet, printed 1-32. PDF 1 (595 x 772 pt) is the cover (MSL4, ADVENTURE and 6904) and PDF 36 (595 x 772 pt) the back cover (the blurb and the ISBN, no product code read). PDF 2 (594 x 767 pt) is the inside front cover, the map Ryker's Island of Tomorrow with its key, and PDF 35 (594 x 767 pt) the inside back cover, the map Ryker's Island of Today. None of PDF 1, 2, 35 and 36 prints a folio or a stat block. The scan holds no map sheet. Survey msl4.md, The scan and Offset.
msl4.stat_labels_note: Every grid in the book (11 read on the page images at 110-120 dpi 2026-11-02) is three stacked rows across one column, the letters F A S E R I P, the rank codes in capitals, then the numbers, each code above its number with no brackets (MSL1's, MSL2's and MSL3's shape), then Health: at the left and Karma: at the right on one line. The eight roster grids (printed 27-31) print a second line, Resources: at the left and Popularity: at the right; the three adventure grids (the Spy-Eye, printed 14; the Spray-Bots and the Phase-Bot, 17) print Health and Karma only. Annihilus's Karma is set with no space after the colon (Karma:70) and his Popularity is a minus with a space before the number (-30), printed 27. Resources is a code and its number in brackets: MN (75) for Annihilus, FB (2) for the five cyborg and City Scout cards, AM (50) for Stygorr and his human form. Every other Popularity is 0.
msl4.section_labels_note: Counted on the OCR of PDF 16, 19-20 and 29-33 and read on the page images 2026-11-02. KNOWN POWERS in bold capitals with no colon heads the powers of all eleven grids, on a line of its own, but Fiona Dunbar's (printed 29), which runs into the word None on its line; Stygorr's human form is printed inside his. Each power is an italic run-in with a colon, stunts and options as bulleted lines. Each roster header is followed by a title-case line in a subhead face reading Real Name: and the name (Irrelevant on the Mark I and Mark II, two names on the Mark III); the three adventure grids print no real-name line and no label but KNOWN POWERS. No CONTACTS, Background or Weakness anywhere.
msl4.rank_aliases_note: The codes the eleven grids print, in capitals, read on the page images 2026-11-02: FB and FE both for Feeble (FB on Rigger's F and S, printed 30, and in the Resources of the five cyborg and City Scout cards; FE on the Spray-Bots' and the Phase-Bot's I and P, printed 17), PR, TY, GD, EX, RM, IN, AM (Annihilus's S; Stygorr's Resources) and MN (Annihilus's E and Resources, printed 27, the only Monstrous).
